items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... Welcome Karolina Strassmayer. [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: Karolina was interviewed via Zoom on May 25, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I am in Central New York State and now I’m talking to someone in Cologne, Germany. Welcome Karolina Strassmayer.
Thank you, Monk. I appreciate it very much.
